layer_definitions.L1-encoding-layout: Guaranteed solely by PER/OER wire layout; BER/DER TLV gives no such guarantee.
layer_definitions.L2-check-types: Optional encode-only check_types step; validates Python types (INTEGER accepts int|str) and never value ranges.
layer_definitions.L3-check-constraints: Runs only when check_constraints=True; off by default on every entry point.
layer_definitions.L4-unsupported-or-ignored: No compiler mechanism enforces the statement; never an admission guarantee.

status_vocabulary.enforced: Rejected automatically at the named layer.
status_vocabulary.optional-enforcement: Rejected only if the caller explicitly enables the layer.
status_vocabulary.conditional-layout-enforcement: Partially enforced: in-root values only; extension values bypass it.
status_vocabulary.not-enforced-silent: Accepted without error; silent value truncation possible.
status_vocabulary.not-enforced-unsupported: Schema rejected at compile/parse time or NotImplementedError at runtime.
